messages.text: Is it possible to get my $595 in store credit as a refund to my paypal account?

Store credit sits on your account and comes off at checkout on your next order. It isn't paid out to PayPal as a rule, so turning it into cash would have to go to a supervisor for review.

Happy to put that request in if you'd like. What's your order number, and the email or postcode ····?

It is for Order Shop····
email is (email hidden)
postcode ····
Handed to the team · Converting store credit to a PayPal payout is money moving and not mine to do.

Thanks, Brian. I can see the $595.00 on your account as store credit from the cancelled Shop····, and it applies at checkout on your next order.

Paying it out to PayPal instead isn't something I can do, so I've put the request to a supervisor to review. The team is offline right now and picks it up in the morning, and they'll come back to you by email at (email hidden) I won't promise an outcome before they've looked.
Thank you. Please keep me up to date with the request for a pay out to PayPayl and any specifics with the process such as cancellation fees and such.

Will do, Brian. Everything the supervisor decides comes to you by email at (email hidden), including any specifics on how a payout would work, so you'll have it in writing. A copy of this chat goes to that address too once we're done here.

I don't want to guess at fees or amounts ahead of their review, so I'll leave that to them rather than tell you something that changes later. If anything moves on your side in the meantime, just come back here.
